item.tib: che mchog dran pa yang gsang drag po'i rgyud rkang gling thod chen ma mo 'bum bskul
item.coloph: bdag 'dra o rgyan sangs rgyas gling pas rab brten lcags phag lo'i zla tshes nyin par las/ nyi ma rang shar gnas kyi g.yon phyogs mkha' 'gro seng gdong (phug nas) spyan drangs nas/ slar zla tshes la pho brang chen po drug zur rnam rgyal rdzong gi dbus rtse las mkha' 'gro'i shog ser bod yig du (tu) phab grub pa bgyis so//
